status: ASSUMED / pre-measurement. No Temper coil or pan has been measured.
model:
(turns-independent ratios, as coil_mc.rs uses):
  L_eq(f)   = L0 * kl40 * (f/40k)^beta                  (loaded series inductance)
  R_eq(f)   = L0 * q40 * (f/40k)^gamma                 (coil winding AC resistance)
            + L0 * r40 * (f/40k)^alpha                 (pan reflected resistance)
  L0 = no-pan coil inductance; kl40 = L_loaded/L0; r40, q40 in ohm per uH of L0.
For a fixed winding geometry L0, R_coil and R_reflected all scale as N^2, so the
ratios transfer between coils of the same geometry with different turn counts; they do
NOT transfer exactly between different geometries (diameter, ferrite, gap).

L0_uH.basis: ESTIMATE: 70 uH is the native-21 design value (power-stage README; coil_mc.rs selected design); +/-10 % is the tolerance TANK_COIL_SPECIFICATION.md s.1 row 1 imposes on its 88 uH coil. No 70 uH coil is specified or measured.

q40_ohm_per_uH.basis: ANCHOR+ESTIMATE: onsemi no-pan coil 0.0024, Infineon kit coil 0.0041 (digitized, 40 kHz, ~25 C); max = TANK_COIL_SPECIFICATION row 5 ceiling 0.40 ohm/88 uH = 0.0045 x 1.29 for a 100 C winding (Cu +0.393 %/K x 75 K, calculation)

gamma_coil.basis: ANCHOR: R_coil ~ f^gamma, onsemi 0.52, Infineon 0.59 over 30-50 kHz

beta_kl.basis: ANCHOR: L_loaded ~ f^beta, onsemi cast iron -0.15 (30-50 kHz), Infineon vessel -0.11 (30-45 kHz)

cast_iron.basis: ANCHOR kl: onsemi 0.66, Infineon vessel 0.68, MDPI 0.82; r: onsemi 0.035, Infineon 0.033, MDPI 0.034-0.036. ESTIMATE: min r = lowest anchor -12 % (cold, small-signal, part spread); max r = +30 % for a hot pan (iron resistivity rises with temperature; R_sheet ~ sqrt(rho*mu)); kl min = lowest anchor -6 % for gap/centring.

enamelled_steel.basis: ANCHOR: MDPI Silit Silargan (enamelled steel) kl 0.63, r 0.018-0.020; onsemi 430 kl 0.65. ESTIMATE: nominal between the Silargan point and the ferritic-steel points; max r hot +30 %.

ss1810_ferromagnetic_base.basis: ANCHOR: MDPI stainless kl 0.74, r 0.027-0.029; onsemi Duxtop 18/10 with magnetic base: R within line width of cast iron at >=30 kHz, kl 0.73 at 25 kHz. ESTIMATE: ranges +/-15-25 %.

thin_stainless_single_ply.basis: ANCHOR: onsemi Midea 430 kl 0.65, R within line width of cast iron at >=30 kHz. CALCULATION: skin depth in ferritic 430 at 40 kHz is 0.07-0.2 mm for mu_r 100-700 (rho 0.6 uOhm.m), so a 0.5-1 mm base is electrically thick. ESTIMATE: low kl/r for warped or lifted thin bases. Non-magnetic single-ply 18/10 is NOT in this class (treated as a detection/fault load).

aluminium_clad_multiply.basis: ANCHOR: onsemi 5-ply (430 exterior, Al core) r 0.030 at 40 kHz, alpha 0.80 (thin ferritic layer); kl hidden under the ferrous traces (taken as ferrous). coil_mc.rs tri-ply GUESS 0.018-0.032 agrees. ESTIMATE: ranges.

offset_or_small_pan_SYNTHETIC.basis: Carried unchanged from coil_mc.rs (synthetic half-coupling construction, no measured anchor).

aluminium_or_nonmagnetic_ss.basis: ANCHOR: onsemi aluminium pan (kl 0.49, reflected R 0.08 ohm on 110 uH). Non-magnetic single-ply 18/10 has no anchor; ESTIMATE: treated as this low-R, low-L load. Must be rejected by pan detection, not heated.
